evals.name: complex-breaking-change
evals.prompt: Draft only the MR description from these verified facts. Purpose: make deployment routing explicit and consistent across environments. Final diff: one environment map replaces DEPLOY_TARGET, DEPLOY_REGION and DEPLOY_CREDENTIAL; scheduled and manual deployments resolve the same target; generated configuration and credentials are limited to the selected environment; the deploy command prints the resolved target. Operators must remove the retired keys and define the environment map before deploying. Verified: configuration parsing and target selection pass for development, staging and production. Implementation notes: six files changed, a resolver helper was renamed twice, 48 tests pass, and an earlier nested-map approach was reverted. Use only these facts. Do not post, use tools or add attribution.
assertions: Opens with the deployment-routing outcome and purpose
Groups all four reviewer-relevant behavior changes without a file inventory
Makes the retired keys and required operator migration easy to find
Includes the supplied validation without test counts or command output
Omits investigation history and internal helper details
Uses useful sections for the complex breaking change without empty headings
Returns only the description, with no em or en dashes outside quotes or code

evals.name: cross-cutting-contract-coverage
evals.prompt: Draft only the MR description from these verified facts. Purpose: serve a browser frontend and its API from one origin so requests do not need CORS or cross-origin basic authentication. Final diff: the frontend owns the public ingress and routes /api to the API service; the API has no public ingress or hostname of its own but stays reachable through /api and inside the cluster; the public project configuration is FRONTEND_INGRESS_ROUTES with path /api and application api plus API_INGRESS_ENABLED set to false; deployment environment URLs are now derived from that route instead of configured as literals; the frontend, API and shared platform package releases are updated to versions that provide this contract. Local development remains out of scope. Commit history includes two discarded ingress designs. No validation result is supplied. Use only these facts. Do not post, use tools or add attribution.
assertions: Opens with the one-origin outcome and explains why it matters
States that the frontend owns the ingress and routes /api to the API service
States that the API has neither a public ingress nor a hostname of its own
Includes the complete public configuration contract without file narration
Preserves derived environment URLs and the package releases that enable the contract
Keeps local development explicitly out of scope
Omits discarded designs and commit history
Invents no validation result
Uses useful structure without empty sections or repeated facts
Returns only the description, with no em or en dashes outside quotes or code
